firm_data.firm_description: Hollander Legal Group, P.C. is a New York based law firm committed to client success in and out of the courtroom. Primarily focused on insurance and criminal defense matters, our attorneys are results driven and provide high quality legal representation.
notable_facts: Named a Super Lawyer “Rising Star” in the Metro New York area in Insurance Coverage in 2014, 2015, and 2017 (Allan S. Hollander).
Selected as a Top Attorney of North America in the 2015-2016 edition of the Who’s Who Directory (Allan S. Hollander).

email.subject: AI for Hollander Legal Group, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Allan,

Your Super Lawyer Rising Star recognition in Insurance Coverage reflects exactly the kind of results-driven practice we work with. At firms balancing high-stakes insurance and criminal defense matters with lean teams, precision and efficiency aren't luxuries.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with smaller rosters. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on what matters to practices like yours: client trust, workflow speed, and defensible work product.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're expanding into the Metro New York area. I'd be happy to stop by Melville to share how we're helping similar firms compete without adding headcount.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
